description: Classify all ClinVar P/LP DMD alleles by mechanism and test frame effect vs Duchenne/Becker phenotype label
code:
import requests, json, time, re, os
from collections import Counter
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy import stats
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

B="https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/"
PLP='("clinsig pathogenic"[Properties] OR "clinsig likely pathogenic"[Properties])'
def esearch_ids(term):
    r=requests.get(B+"esearch.fcgi", params={"db":"clinvar","term":term,"retmax":10000,"retmode":"json"}, timeout=120)
    j=r.json()["esearchresult"]; return int(j["count"]), set(j.get("idlist",[]))

sets={}; counts={}
for k,q in {"DMD":f'DMD[gene] AND "Duchenne muscular dystrophy"[dis] AND {PLP}',
            "BMD":f'DMD[gene] AND "Becker muscular dystrophy"[dis] AND {PLP}',
            "DCM":f'DMD[gene] AND "dilated cardiomyopathy"[dis] AND {PLP}',
            "ALL":f'DMD[gene] AND {PLP}'}.items():
    c,s=esearch_ids(q); counts[k]=c; sets[k]=s; time.sleep(0.35)
ids=sorted(sets["ALL"]); recs=[]
for i in range(0,len(ids),200):
    ch=ids[i:i+200]
    for a in range(5):
        try:
            j=requests.post(B+"esummary.fcgi", data={"db":"clinvar","id":",".join(ch),"retmode":"json"}, timeout=180).json()["result"]
            recs+= [j[u] for u in j["uids"]]; break
        except Exception: time.sleep(3)
    time.sleep(0.3)
json.dump(recs, open("clinvar_dmd_plp_esummary_raw.json","w"))
print("records", len(recs), "/", counts["ALL"])

pat = re.compile(r'c\.(-?\*?-?\d+)([+-]\d+)?(?:_(\*?-?\d+)([+-]\d+)?)?(delins|del|dup|ins|inv)')
def coding_span(cdna):
    m=pat.search(cdna or "")
    if not m: return None
    a_s,a_off,b_s,b_off,ev=m.groups()
    if ev not in ("del","dup"): return (ev,None,None)
    if any(x and '*' in x for x in (a_s,b_s)): return (ev,None,None)
    try: a=int(a_s); b=int(b_s) if b_s else a
    except: return (ev,None,None)
    if a<0 or b<0: return (ev,None,None)
    ao=int(a_off or 0); bo=int(b_off or 0)
    s=a+(1 if ao>0 else 0); e=b-(1 if bo<0 else 0)
    n=e-s+1
    return (ev,n,(n%3)) if n>0 else (ev,None,None)

def classify(r):
    title=r.get("title",""); obj=r.get("obj_type","")
    vs=(r.get("variation_set") or [{}])[0]
    cdna=vs.get("cdna_change") or title
    prot=(vs.get("variation_name","") or "")+ " " + title
    cs=coding_span(cdna)
    ev,n,f = cs if cs else (None,None,None)
    # mechanism class
    if "Ter" in prot or "*" in (r.get("protein_change") or "") or re.search(r'p\.[A-Z][a-z]{2}\d+(Ter|\*)', prot):
        return "nonsense", ev, n, f
    if ev in ("del","dup") and f is not None:
        return ("frameshift" if f!=0 else "in-frame indel"), ev, n, f
    if obj=="single nucleotide variant":
        if re.search(r'c\.\d+[+-][12][ACGT]>', cdna) or re.search(r'c\.-?\d+[+-]\d+[ACGT]>', cdna):
            return "splice-site", ev, n, f
        if re.search(r'p\.[A-Z][a-z]{2}\d+[A-Z][a-z]{2}', prot): return "missense", ev, n, f
        return "other SNV", ev, n, f
    if obj in ("copy number loss","copy number gain"): return "large CNV (frame unknown)", ev, n, f
    if ev in ("del","dup"): return "indel (frame unparsed)", ev, n, f
    return "other", ev, n, f

rows=[]
for r in recs:
    cl,ev,n,f = classify(r)
    uid=r.get("uid")
    ph=[k for k in ("DMD","BMD","DCM") if uid in sets[k]]
    rows.append(dict(uid=uid, accession=r.get("accession"), obj_type=r.get("obj_type"),
                     title=r.get("title"), mech_class=cl, event=ev, nbases=n, frame_mod3=f,
                     pheno=";".join(ph) or "none"))
df=pd.DataFrame(rows); df.to_csv("clinvar_dmd_plp_classified.csv", index=False)
print(df.mech_class.value_counts().to_string())

# --- Test 1: frame-disrupting vs frame-preserving by exclusive phenotype label ---
trunc={"frameshift","nonsense","splice-site"}
pres={"in-frame indel","missense"}
d=df[df.mech_class.isin(trunc|pres) & df.pheno.isin(["DMD","BMD"])].copy()
d["effect"]=np.where(d.mech_class.isin(trunc),"frame-disrupting/truncating","frame-preserving")
ct=pd.crosstab(d.effect,d.pheno).reindex(index=["frame-disrupting/truncating","frame-preserving"],columns=["DMD","BMD"])
print("\nTest1 contingency (ClinVar exclusive labels):\n",ct)
orr,p=stats.fisher_exact(ct.values)
# 95% CI for OR (Woolf)
a,b_,c_,d_=ct.values.ravel()
se=np.sqrt(sum(1/max(x,0.5) for x in (a,b_,c_,d_))); lo,hi=np.exp(np.log(max(orr,1e-9))-1.96*se),np.exp(np.log(max(orr,1e-9))+1.96*se)
print(f"OR(truncating -> DMD vs BMD) = {orr:.2f} [95% CI {lo:.2f}-{hi:.2f}], Fisher p = {p:.3g}, N={ct.values.sum()}")
print("Share frame-preserving among BMD-labelled: %.1f%%; among DMD-labelled: %.1f%%" %
      (100*ct.loc['frame-preserving','BMD']/ct['BMD'].sum(), 100*ct.loc['frame-preserving','DMD']/ct['DMD'].sum()))

# --- Test 2: overall mechanism spectrum of P/LP DMD alleles ---
tot=len(df); ntrunc=df.mech_class.isin(trunc).sum(); npres=df.mech_class.isin(pres).sum()
print(f"\nTest2: {ntrunc}/{tot} ({100*ntrunc/tot:.1f}%) of ClinVar P/LP DMD alleles are truncating/frame-disrupting; "
      f"{npres} ({100*npres/tot:.1f}%) are frame-preserving.")

# --- Figure ---
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2, figsize=(12,4.6))
vc=df.mech_class.value_counts()
axes[0].barh(vc.index[::-1], vc.values[::-1], color="#4C72B0")
axes[0].set_xlabel("ClinVar P/LP alleles (n)"); axes[0].set_title("Mechanism spectrum of pathogenic DMD alleles\n(ClinVar, retrieved 2026-11-25)")
for i,v in enumerate(vc.values[::-1]): axes[0].text(v+20,i,str(v),va="center",fontsize=8)
pct=(ct/ct.sum()*100)
pct.T.plot(kind="bar", stacked=True, ax=axes[1], color=["#C44E52","#55A868"], rot=0)
axes[1].set_ylabel("% of alleles with that phenotype label"); axes[1].set_xlabel("ClinVar condition label (exclusive)")
axes[1].set_title(f"Frame effect vs phenotype label\nOR={orr:.2f} [{lo:.2f}-{hi:.2f}], p={p:.2g}, N={ct.values.sum()}")
axes[1].legend(fontsize=8, loc="lower right")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
print(json.dumps(counts))
